notes.key_messages:
What candidates did well
• Described how to prepare a standard solution.
• Knew which volumetric instrument to use.
• Plotted points and drew accurate lines of best fit on a graph.
What candidates needed to improve
• Candidates must read through and understand why various steps in an experiment are done in order to
avoid giving responses that contradict the method given. For example, suggesting NaNO would
decompose at 320°C in 1(g) when NaNO is not present in the precipitate formed.
• Avoid giving more than one response when one response is asked for. For example, in 1(d)(v), where
often a second incorrect response such as ‘… and to remove impurities.’ was seen.
